entries.09d141b4e265fcff: This business produces photosensitive materials for semiconductors, photosensitive materials for liquid crystal display devices and electric double-layer materials, among others. Photosensitive materials are manufactured at the Chiba Plant and Ichikawa Plant, and research and development is conducted at the Photosensitive Materials Research Laboratory. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥26,417 million.
